limitations_and_boundaries: Findings are based on mouse models of AD (J20, APP/PS1) and acute oAβ injection paradigms; human relevance remains to be established.
The study focuses on early, pre-plaque stages; later disease stages involving plaques and neuroinflammation are not addressed.
C1q inhibition experiments used a single anti-C1q antibody (ANX-M1); off-target effects cannot be excluded.
Synapse loss was assessed by colocalized pre- and postsynaptic puncta, which may not capture all aspects of synaptic integrity.
The engulfment assay relies on Homer-GFP as a synaptic marker; other synaptic components may be differentially engulfed.
The role of other complement pathways (alternative, lectin) was not investigated.
Sample sizes and statistical details for some experiments are not fully reported in the provided chunks.
